verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. A Song. To You praise [is] waiting, O God, in Zion, and to You the vow will be fulfilled.

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. A Song. To You praise [is] waiting, O God, in Zion, and to You the vow will be fulfilled.

verses.text: O Hearer of prayer, to You all flesh will come.

segments.text: O Hearer of prayer, to You all flesh will come.

verses.text: Matters of iniquities prevail against me—our transgressions, You wipe them away!

segments.text: Matters of iniquities prevail against me—our transgressions, You wipe them away!

verses.text: Blessed [is the one] You choose and bring near, [that] he may dwell in Your courts; we will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

segments.text: Blessed [is the one] You choose and bring near, [that] he may dwell in Your courts; we will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

verses.text: [With] fearsome [things], may You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, the confidence [for] all the farthest ends of the earth and the sea,

segments.text: [With] fearsome [things], may You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, the confidence [for] all the farthest ends of the earth and the sea,

verses.text: the One establishing the mountains by His strength, being girded with might,

segments.text: the One establishing the mountains by His strength, being girded with might,

verses.text: stilling the roaring of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.

segments.text: stilling the roaring of the seas, the roar of their waves, and the uproar of the peoples.

verses.text: And those dwelling [at] the ends were afraid of Your signs; the goings forth of morning and evening You cause to sing.

segments.text: And those dwelling [at] the ends were afraid of Your signs; the goings forth of morning and evening You cause to sing.

verses.text: You attend to the earth and give it abundance; greatly You enrich it; the stream of God is full of water; You provide their grain when thus You prepare it—

segments.text: You attend to the earth and give it abundance; greatly You enrich it; the stream of God is full of water; You provide their grain when thus You prepare it—

verses.text: soaking its furrows, descending [on] its ridges; with showers You soften it; its springing up You bless.

segments.text: soaking its furrows, descending [on] its ridges; with showers You soften it; its springing up You bless.

verses.text: You crown the year [with] Your goodness, and Your tracks drip [with] fatness.

segments.text: You crown the year [with] Your goodness, and Your tracks drip [with] fatness.

verses.text: They drip [on] the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are surrounded [with] joy.

segments.text: They drip [on] the pastures of the wilderness, and the hills are surrounded [with] joy.

verses.text: The meadows are clothed [with] the flock, and the valleys are feeble with grain—they shout [for joy] [and] even sing.

segments.text: The meadows are clothed [with] the flock, and the valleys are feeble with grain—they shout [for joy] [and] even sing.
